meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. Project progress embeds each project’s outcome timeline and product-acceptance reviewer, with duplicate-development checks against requirements and tasks; searchable projects, recent projects and alerts; feedback is recorded by pasting one block of text that is parsed locally. A desktop memo per project can feed the paste box. The talent pool supports creating/deleting employees and CSV/TSV/JSON/Markdown/XLSX import. It also includes the requirement pool, one DSH conversation per project, organization chart, team matching, capability advice and skill research. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
